import _codecs
seen = []
def handler(error):
    seen.append((error.start, error.end, error.reason))
    print('recovery')
    return (b'?', -1)
_codecs.register_error('fault_admission', handler)
result = _codecs.utf_8_encode('A\ud800\udfffZ', 'fault_admission')
assert result == (b'A?Z', 4)
assert seen == [(1, 3, 'surrogates not allowed')]
print('verified')
